references.text: Jesus quoted directly from the Book of Psalms that one who shared bread with him would lift his heel against him, which is fulfilled in Judas's betrayal.
This is the prophetic text Jesus refers to in John 6:70 and 13:18, where a close friend lifts his heel against him.
Jesus confirms that he kept those given to him, except for 'the son of destruction,' who is the same person he called 'a devil' in this verse.
The text describes how the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot to betray Jesus, which is identical to the claim that one of the twelve is a devil.
